race.comment: The Clarken/Sorby look to have a powerful hand here. GRAND MILLESIME (8) did little and finished 4.5 lengths from the winner in fifth over 1250m at Morphettville Parks last start, a less impressive effort than her fourth at Morphettville Parks the run before, but the big thing in her favour is a significant class drop. MAGIC VOYAGER (11) is on debut after placings at her past two trials and draws perfectly in what is not a super-strong event. PIERRE LE QUILL (3) should be at peak fitness now and gets blinkers, so could be an improver. MR NIPPER (2) was beaten 9 lengths into ninth in a 1200m contest at Ballarat Synthetic at his latest appearance. Capable of featuring prominently.
